name: GMDS MISF Top-Level Initializer Experimental Manifest
purpose: Evaluate whether existing graph-drawing layouts in grip, especially the new weighted GRIP sister API with in-core multiscale LGKK refinement, provide better top-level MISF basins for subsequent GMDS correction than cMDS.
core_questions: Which initializer gives the most plausible top MISF scaffold?
Do weighted GRIP variants outperform the unweighted GRIP baseline on these weighted geometric graphs?
Which initializer remains stable under a short regularized-GMDS plus pure-GMDS correction?
Does a better top-level seed improve the full MISF-GMDS pipeline?
If top-level improvement is insufficient, do lower MISF levels also need graph-drawing-based placement?

phases.title: Top-level initializer benchmark
phases.goal: Compare top-level MISF seeds before any GMDS correction.
phases.runs: 3 families x 8 initializers x 1 deterministic seed

phases.title: Top-level initializer plus GMDS correction benchmark
phases.goal: Test which seeds remain good after short regularized and pure GMDS correction.
phases.runs: 3 families x best 2 initializers from Phase A x 3 stages

phases.title: Full MISF pipeline benchmark
phases.goal: Propagate the best top-level strategies through the full multiscale pipeline.
phases.runs: 3 families x baseline current pipeline x best 1-2 top-level strategies

phases.title: Lower-level placement benchmark
phases.goal: Compare lower-level placement variants after top-level seeding is improved.
phases.runs: best top-level strategy x current insertion vs weighted GRIP vs weighted KK vs GRIP vs KK vs optional FR placement

organization: within each phase, group by graph family
show one card per initializer or stage
include weighted trace stages when the initializer itself is multistage
use consistent alignment and camera angle
html_requirements.preferred_delivery: single combined HTML if size is manageable; otherwise one HTML per phase

acceptance_criteria: At least one non-cMDS initializer clearly improves top-level rho and visual plausibility.
At least one weighted GRIP variant beats unweighted GRIP on the weighted paraboloid families.
The best seed plus short GMDS correction remains stable and does not immediately collapse.
The corresponding full MISF pipeline beats the current baseline on at least one regular paraboloid family.
Each experiment phase ships with its corresponding interactive HTML output.
